title: Add focused dotnet test command hook for agent workflows
description:
Problem: agents frequently rebuild long dotnet test filter commands by hand, increasing token usage and typo risk during focused validation loops. Existing workflow guidance already encourages script-driven operations where repeated command construction appears.

Desired outcome: provide a stable hook script that produces focused dotnet test command payloads from test names/categories, with machine-readable output for agent reuse.

Scope:
- In scope: add Scripts/SkillHooks/New-FocusedDotnetTestCommand.ps1.
- In scope: output a compact JSON contract including command text, computed filter, and warnings.
- In scope: add focused usage docs in Scripts/SkillHooks/README.md.
- Out of scope: replacing all test execution scripts or changing test discovery semantics.

Validation:
- Script smoke tests for one-name, multi-name, and empty input behavior.
- Verify generated command executes successfully in at least one focused test scenario.

Confidence target: 93%.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from self-review pass to convert repeated focused test command authoring into a reusable hook contract.
